mapper.select: SELECT M.MTNG_ID, M.MTNG_NM, M.MTNG_TYPE_CD, M.BEGIN_DT, M.END_DT, M.CRTR_ID, E.EMP_NM AS CRTR_NM, M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID, CR.CONF_RM_NM, VC.VCONF_ID, VC.ROOM_NM, CASE WHEN VC.VCONF_ID IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN M.BEGIN_DT > SYSDATE THEN 'VC001' WHEN M.BEGIN_DT <= SYSDATE AND M.END_DT >= SYSDATE THEN 'VC002' ELSE 'VC003' END AS VCONF_STTUS, MOM.MOM_ID, MOM.MOM_STTUS_CD, M.DEL_YN FROM TB_MTNG M LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = M.CRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_VIDEO_CONF VC ON VC.MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM_RSRV RR ON RR.RSRV_ID = M.CONF_RM_RSRV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONF_RM CR ON CR.CONF_RM_ID = RR.CONF_RM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG_MOM MOM ON MOM.MOM_ID = ( SELECT MAX(MOM_ID) FROM TB_MTNG_MOM WHERE MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND DEL_DT IS NULL ) WHERE M.MTNG_ID = #{mtngId}

SELECT P.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM, J.JOB_GRD_NM FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT P LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = P.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE J ON J.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD WHERE P.MTNG_ID = #{mtngId} ORDER BY E.EMP_NM ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(M.BEGIN_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND M.BEGIN_DT > SYSDATE AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TODAY_SCHEDULED_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN M.BEGIN_DT <= SYSDATE AND M.END_DT >= SYSDATE AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IN_PROGRESS_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN TRUNC(M.END_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND M.END_DT < SYSDATE AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN MOM.MOM_STTUS_CD = '01' AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AI_PENDING_CNT FROM TB_MTNG M LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG_MOM MOM ON MOM.MOM_ID = ( SELECT MAX(MOM_ID) FROM TB_MTNG_MOM WHERE MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND DEL_DT IS NULL )
SELECT M.MTNG_TYPE_CD AS CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_MTNG M WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY M.MTNG_TYPE_CD ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'YYYY-MM') AS CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_MTNG M WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND M.BEGIN_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY CATEGORY ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'HH24') AS CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_MTNG M WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'HH24')) BETWEEN 9 AND 18 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'HH24') ORDER BY CATEGORY ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN MOM.MOM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) ) END FROM TB_MTNG M LEFT JOIN TB_MTNG_MOM MOM ON MOM.MOM_ID = ( SELECT MAX(MOM_ID) FROM TB_MTNG_MOM WHERE MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND DEL_DT IS NULL ) WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND M.END_DT < SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MTNG SET END_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MTNG_ID = #{mtngId} AND BEGIN_DT <= SYSDATE AND END_DT >= SYSDATE AND DEL_YN = 'N'
